statements.text: The model has 20 layers, model dimension 1280 and 16 heads.
The context patch length is 32 and the forecast-horizon patch length is 64.
The whole horizon is decoded in one forward pass using placeholder tokens that the blog calls Contiguous Patch Masking.
The stack alternates causal temporal attention with full variate attention.
The architecture is labeled 'Stacked Mixing Transformer with Variate Attention and CPM Iterative RevIN'; the card does not define these terms.
The card's pointers to 'the paper' lead to the 2023 TimesFM paper, which predates this release.

unresolved.issue: 330 million parameters versus 20 layers, width 1280 and 16 heads: the pages do not state how, or whether, the two relate.
32-step patches (blog) versus context patch 32 and horizon patch 64 (card): the pages do not state how the 64 relates to the blog's description.
The blog says it builds on predecessors' decoder-only design and also describes whole-horizon single-pass decoding with placeholders: a documented hybrid, not plain autoregression.
